<!--
Reusable authoring patterns. Copy the needed block into a lesson and replace its
contents; do not include this entire file in a published page.
-->

::: {.definition}
### Definition
State the mathematical object, domain, and notation, then give a minimal example.
:::

::: {.theorem}
### Theorem or rule
State every hypothesis and the conclusion precisely.
:::

::: {.intuition}
### Intuition
Connect the formal statement to a visual, limiting case, or invariant.
:::

::: {.worked-example}
### Worked example
State the problem, plan the method, justify each step, interpret, and verify.
:::

::: {.common-mistake}
### Common mistake
Show an incorrect step, explain why it fails, and repair it.
:::

::: {.practice-box data-skill-mode="symbolic-reasoning"}
### Practice
Give a focused task with a hint and a collapsed, step-by-step solution.
:::

::: {.checkpoint data-skill-mode="interpretation"}
### Checkpoint
Ask for a prediction or interpretation before revealing the explanation.
:::

::: {.computation}
### Computational activity
Label the activity, predict first, compute reproducibly, interpret, and verify.
:::
